title: Project Overview
description: Start with the main README to understand the project's purpose: a lifecycle API management and security governance platform. It provides a high-level view of the features, including gateway integration, analytics, and security guardrails.

title: System Architecture
description: The ARCHITECTURE.md document provides a detailed breakdown of the system's components. It explains the relationship between the control plane (ASP.NET Core), the data plane (Apache APISIX), and the observability stack (ELK/Grafana).

title: Backend Entry Point
description: The MilkAdminBlazor Program.cs is the primary entry point for the management dashboard and control plane. It bootstraps the .NET 8 application, configures dependency injection, and sets up the middleware pipeline for security and logging.
languageLesson: .NET 8 uses the minimal hosting model, where the builder pattern is used to configure services and the app pipeline in a concise way.

title: Core API Controllers
description: The Controllers in MilkApiManager handle the management operations for APIs, consumers, and security rules. These endpoints form the internal API that the Blazor dashboard and SDKs interact with.

title: Data Persistence
description: The AppDbContext defines the database schema using Entity Framework Core. It manages the lifecycle of API configurations, consumer data, and audit logs, ensuring data consistency across the management platform.
languageLesson: Entity Framework Core uses a Code-First approach, where C# classes (Models) define the database schema, and Migrations track changes over time.

title: API Gateway Configuration
description: Apache APISIX is the core of the data plane. The config.yaml and custom Lua plugins define how traffic is routed, masked (PII masking), and blocked (security automation) at the edge.

title: Security Automation
description: The system includes automated guardrails like key rotation and traffic blocking. The KeyRotationBackgroundService manages the lifecycle of API keys, while design docs outline the auto-blocking logic.

title: Management Dashboard
description: The Blazor-based UI provides a dark trading-terminal themed interface for managing the gateway. Pages like GatewayDashboard and ApiInventory allow operators to monitor and configure the system in real-time.
languageLesson: Blazor components use the .razor syntax, combining HTML with C# logic to create interactive SPAs (Single Page Applications).

title: Python SDK
description: The system provides a Python SDK for programmatic access to the management APIs. This allows for automated onboarding and integration with other developer tools and workflows.

title: Deployment & Infrastructure
description: The project is containerized using Docker and orchestrated with Docker Compose. This ensures a consistent environment across development, testing, and production, including the gateway, backend, and monitoring stack.
